name: Fieldproxy
long_description: Fieldproxy is AI-native field service management software that is set up around how each business already works. It covers jobs, scheduling and dispatch, an offline technician app, quotes, invoices and checklists, with AI agents that answer calls and texts, read photos and documents, and flag problems. Fieldproxy's team builds each customer's fields, stages and forms, so a rollout takes days, and it connects to Claude and ChatGPT through an official MCP server.
one_liner: AI-native field service software built around how you work
